scope: Reviewed M4 implementation paths and point-in-time evidence hashes. There is no full pre-M4 file tree or Git index; addition/modification labels describe reviewed work, not an independently reconstructed exhaustive Git diff. Only the 86 recorded pre-M4 paths support byte-level preservation claims.
selfHashRule: These two inventory files are excluded from their own hashes to avoid circular checksums.
excluded: node_modules, target, dist and Python caches
actively written policy rows and execution logs
unchanged historical sources/files outside the recorded baseline
individual generated corpus case files (declared membership and fingerprints are in generation_manifest.json)
